observed.caption: A detailed scale model of a town with roads, buildings, trees, a river and a train is displayed inside a glass case.
observed.description: A large detailed scale model of a town is displayed inside a transparent glass case resting on a parquet wooden floor, showing a network of gray roads and roundabouts, numerous miniature buildings with red, brown, blue, white and green roofs, patches of green and small dark trees representing parks and vegetation, a winding blue strip representing a river along the right side, a railway track with a white train and blue car along the bottom edge, and small light-colored vehicles arranged in central parking areas, with reflections and glare visible on the glass surfaces and a herringbone-patterned wooden floor in the background.
